ios.desc:
Since 2015, AdBlock Pro for Safari has been trusted by millions of users and featured by Apple multiple times. Enhance your browsing experience on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro with our powerful ad-blocking solution.

Core Features:
• Block Ads: Eliminate pop-ups, banners, autoplay videos, and more.
• Preserve Privacy: Block trackers that collect your data online.
• Speed up Browsing: Load pages 2-4x faster and save up to 60% data.
• Save Battery: Extend battery life by reducing resource usage.
• Eliminate Annoyances: Remove cookie prompts and similar distractions.

Additional Features:
• iCloud Sync: Seamlessly sync settings across all your devices.
• Family Sharing: Share the app with up to 5 family members.
• HTTPS Only Mode: Ensure all your connections are secure.
• Quick Access: Use the built-in Safari shortcut for easy adjustments.
• Custom Blocking: Select and hide specific elements on websites.
• Picture-in-Picture: Watch videos while multitasking.
• Block Miners: Prevent cryptocurrency mining scripts from running.
• Blocking Scripts: Disable unwanted JavaScript.
• Block Adult Content: Make browsing safer for kids.
• Frequent Updates: Enjoy regular performance improvements.
• Helpful Support: Access a dedicated support team for assistance.
• Localized: Fully translated UI in 60+ languages.
• And more...

Supported Language Ad Filters:
• English, Japanese, Indonesian, Russian, Persian, Latvian, Romanian, Bulgarian, Finnish, Korean, Swedish, Italian, French, Polish, Dutch, Estonian, Hebrew, Icelandic, Lithuanian, Danish, Greek, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, Czech, Slovak, Norwegian, Hungarian, Chinese, German, Vietnamese, Arabic.

How It Works:
• Our app uses Apple’s native Content Blocking API to feed blocking rules to Safari without accessing your browsing data.

Compatibility:
• Available for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS.

Report Ads:
• Help us improve by reporting ads within the app.

Join the Movement:
• Love the app? Leave a review and share with friends!

Premium and Terms:
AdBlock Pro for Safari is free to download and includes powerful ad blocking for Safari. Premium unlocks enhanced country-specific ad blocking, additional blocking categories, and automatic filter updates.

Premium may be available as a subscription or one-time purchase depending on your region and current App Store offer. Current pricing, trial availability, and renewal terms are shown in the App Store purchase sheet before confirmation.
